title: FairMark AI
description: AI-assisted assignment evaluation for Canvas, Moodle & Blackboard. Instructors keep full control of every final grade.
overview: FairMark AI evaluates student submissions against the instructor’s rubric, giving every instructor a transparent, evidence-backed starting point. The instructor stays in control of every final grade.

It plugs directly into the LMS through LTI 1.3, so there are no new portals and no student training. Students submit as normal, the AI pre-evaluates, the instructor reviews, and the final grade posts back to the gradebook.
features: Evidence-grounded scores: each rubric criterion cites exact passages, slides or lines
Immutable AI lock: evaluations are cryptographically timestamped on generation
Automatic grade passback to the LMS gradebook via LTI Advantage (AGS)
Configurable late-penalty engine with grace periods and hard cutoffs
Downloadable PDF evaluation report for every submission
Handles PDF, PPTX, DOCX and images, with slide- and page-level evidence

title: Plasmin 0.1
description: Messenger bot to find plasma donors in your area, filtering by blood group and location.
overview: Built during the COVID-19 pandemic, Plasmin is a Facebook Messenger chatbot that connects patients who need convalescent plasma with recovered donors nearby.
Users can register as donors or search by blood group and district, all within a familiar chat interface.
features: Conversational donor registration and search inside Facebook Messenger
Filtering by blood group and location
Spring Boot backend with JPA and a MySQL database

title: Secure University Systems
description: End-to-end secure academic information systems for universities and institutions.
overview: A suite of academic information systems — admissions, results, course registration and administration — designed with security as a first-class requirement.
Hardened authentication, fine-grained authorisation and audit trails protect sensitive student and institutional data.
features: JWT-based stateless authentication with refresh rotation
Role- and attribute-based access control
Audit logging for every sensitive operation
OWASP Top 10 mitigations baked into the framework

title: Space4E
description: Platform empowering space education, events and community for young explorers.
overview: Space4E brings space science to young learners through events, learning resources and an online community.
The platform handles event registration, content publishing and community engagement.
features: Event creation, registration and ticketing
Learning content and resource library
Community profiles and announcements
Cloud-hosted on AWS

title: Diamond in the Sky
description: Interactive space-learning app that teaches kids aged 10–12 about space science using official NASA data.
overview: Built by Team Diamonds for the NASA International Space Apps Challenge 2022. The team first became National Champion in Bangladesh, then won the global Most Inspirational Award, one of the challenge's global winner categories.
The app makes stellar phenomena approachable for children aged 10 to 12, turning official NASA data into an interactive learning experience.
features: Learn mode: interesting facts about stars and constellations
Play mode: draw a constellation's star pattern to advance a level
Later levels let kids vary a star's distance, temperature and mass to see how it changes
Built for the “Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star” challenge on stellar variability

title: Beyond CVSS
description: Predicting which vulnerabilities will actually be exploited, beyond static CVSS scores.
overview: A research project that uses CISA's Known Exploited Vulnerabilities (KEV) catalogue to train models that prioritise vulnerabilities by real-world exploitation risk rather than severity alone.
features: Feature engineering from CVE, CVSS and KEV data
Exploitation-likelihood prediction models
Comparison against CVSS-only prioritisation

title: dbdiagram PWA
description: Free ER-diagram tool with real-time sync between text, visual diagram and SQL.
overview: A free, installable progressive web app for designing database schemas. Write DBML-style text, see the diagram update live, and export SQL.
features: Two-way sync between text, diagram and SQL
Offline-capable PWA
Export to SQL and images

title: COVID-19 Visualizer BD
description: Interactive district-level map of COVID-19 cases across Bangladesh.
overview: An interactive Bangladesh map that shows the latest COVID-19 figures for every district. Click a district to see its case count.
features: Clickable SVG map of all 64 districts
Daily and cumulative case, recovery and death counts
Bangla-language interface

title: Online Voting System
description: Capstone CR election and voting management system written in C/C++.
overview: A console-based class-representative election system built as a software development capstone project (SE-133).
features: Voter and candidate management
Secure one-person-one-vote casting
Automated tallying and results
